propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store must persist code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity distribution, clone count) per CI run so their trend history accumulates rather than remaining ephemeral.

The snapshot file must be stored at .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (a git-tracked path) and not under reports/ (which is gitignored), requiring a negation entry in .gitignore to prevent it from being silently excluded by the blanket .rebar/* rule.
write_snapshot(dict) must append timestamped records to the NDJSON file and read_snapshots(since, until) must yield records within the date range, filtering out-of-range entries.
The reader must gracefully skip malformed or truncated NDJSON lines and return only valid records without raising an error.
